text: m1: ACCEPT on abdc219, no required findings. Reviewed the exact delta, not the description: rename of nodeLemmasFrom to nodeLemmasFromRawTerms at definition plus eight call sites, and one new test pinning contains("isol") and !contains("isolated"). No production change. The identity-stemmer mutation proof is the one I wanted - old suite passed 2/2 under the mutant (the vacuity I raised), new law fails under the identical mutant with 2 siblings still passing, so it fails for the right reason rather than taking the suite down. The engineer improved on my suggestion: I proposed nodes.head, they used .find(_.ref == e1) with an explicit failure message, which cannot silently start testing a different node if the fixture is reordered. Noted for the record: this test will fail if Porter ever stems 'isolated' to something other than 'isol' - that is correct and intended, and whoever hits it should update the literal deliberately rather than delete the test.
